summary: Ark 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (the Trust) filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Pricing Benchmark Licensing Agreement with CF Benchmarks Ltd., effective August 31, 2026. The Sponsor, 21Shares US LLC, initiated the termination to transition to a new benchmark provider, FTSE International Limited, with a licensing agreement expected around August 24, 2026. The CF Benchmarks agreement had a one-year initial term with automatic renewals. The FTSE license will also have a one-year initial term and auto-renew. No termination fee or premium is disclosed. This is an operational change, not a special situation. Watch for confirmation of the new licensing agreement.
